title: Chore Rulebook
user: A household sharing recurring chores who needs transparent assignment rules and a lightweight completion history, without gamifying domestic work or requiring every member to create an account.
smallest_useful_product: Offline shared-device PWA with named people, chores, interval/effort, rotation or fixed-owner rule, a 'why assigned' explanation, and a local history export.
constraints: No child profiling or behavioral scoring; device-local data and printable QR pairing; support accessibility and plain-language assignments.
